selection_note: Scenario ideas only. No v2 answer key, ranked product, URL, verdict, or gold is inherited. Technology-heavy candidates are preferred because the current Postmill snapshot is most likely to contain a real complementary community leg; every leg still requires frozen-span review.

candidates.rationale: Explicit budget and two action bundles can support a decidable tradeoff if stocked attributes exist.
Marketing claims can be paired with mechanism evidence and condition-specific community counterexamples.
Store ratings and long-term failure reports suggest a genuine reconciliation motif.
Replaceability attributes plus observed failure modes may produce hard durability filters.
The plan's worked example; retain only if seal, aircraft-noise, form-factor and glasses-user evidence all exist.
A fixed budget and typing/gaming priorities may yield an admissible candidate set.
Polling/debounce/rollover claims are typed and potentially mechanism-grounded.
High ratings versus chatter reports can form a condition-limited conclusion.
Component failure evidence may invalidate switch-lifetime-only choices.
Layout, arrows, wireless and battery constraints are explicit but require stocked attributes.
Budget tier and longevity can be decidable only with explicit priority and update/battery evidence.
Charging claims require product compatibility plus battery/thermal mechanism evidence.
Ratings versus failure reports can be reconciled using typed electrical safeguards.
Cold-cell mechanism and concrete accessory attributes may yield a constrained setup.
Inductive-transfer mechanism can qualify wattage and heat claims if body evidence exists.
Budget, couch co-op and ordinary-display constraints are explicit candidate filters.
4K/frame-rate/ray-tracing claims require both device and display conditions.
Material durability and ergonomics claims need distinct mechanism and owner evidence.
Potentiometer/Hall-effect mechanisms plus long-term experience can revise the initial choice.
Anthropometric constraints can be decidable only if dimensions and user evidence are frozen.
